recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中以紅血球前驅細胞為主：核圓、染色質顆粒狀、細胞質深藍色的前紅血球母細胞與嗜鹼性正母紅血球成群出現，呈紅血球系增生，為 PNH 溶血的非特異性骨髓表現。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by erythroid precursors at all stages
Pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts: round nuclei, coarse-granular chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Polychromatophilic normoblasts with grey-blue cytoplasm and condensing chromatin
Occasional granulocytic precursor with granules and a band/segmented neutrophil; granulocytes relatively reduced
Several smudged/crushed nuclei; no obvious significant dyserythropoiesis or blast excess in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows a cellular specimen with prominent erythroid hyperplasia, including numerous pronormoblasts and basophilic normoblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, together with more mature polychromatophilic forms. Erythroid maturation is orderly and overt dysplasia is not evident in this field; granulocytic precursors are relatively decreased. Findings are consistent with a reactive erythroid hyperplasia in the setting of paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; the diagnosis rests on flow cytometry for GPI-anchored proteins.

ddx.vs: MDS shows significant dyserythropoiesis (nuclear budding, multinucleation, ring sideroblasts) and dysgranulopoiesis, which are not evident here.
Megaloblastic precursors have open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant bands/metamyelocytes.
Parvovirus shows a few giant pronormoblasts with nuclear inclusions and absent later erythroid stages, not a full maturation spectrum.
